name: Melanie Harris
source:
Job: Entrepreneur – makes beauty products at home and sells them online/to local shops
Skill: Cleopatra’s Hand
Hobby: Entrepreneurship, gossip magazines, social media
Loves: Fashion, beauty, horror movies
Pet Peeve: Having no internet connection

“I’ve loved you since we were like twelve!”
 
Melanie has been your best friend since you were ten. She always dreams big, no matter what she’s dreaming about. Ultimately, she hopes to establish a large beauty brand in the US and go international someday.

[From the game's [url=http://kissesandcurses.voltage-ent.com/index.php/characters/]website[/url]]
